# Runbook template

Status: template — commands have not been implemented or verified.

## Prerequisites

Actual host, persistent root, environment lock, required release/asset revisions, capacity and unresolved gates.

## Setup and execution

Add the exact tested commands, working directories and resolved configuration. Exclude secrets. Describe expected observable output without fabricating results.

## Reproduce the report and video

Add actual data locations, reconstruction commands, tool versions and artifact checks.

## Interruptions and cleanup

Describe what survives, how to create a new attempt, how to inspect partial evidence, and how to stop only the run's owned processes. Distinguish job restart from physics-state restoration.

## Known failures

Record observed errors, their evidence, verified fixes and remaining limitations.
